subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction use the same drop policy as the prompt-send sanitizer for aborted assistant tool-call turns, accepting small context loss to avoid strict-provider rejection?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and proven, but drop versus synthesize is a session-state recovery policy choice that affects what interrupted turns remain visible after compaction.

options.title: Accept Drop Policy
options.body: Merge this approach after exact-head checks because it matches existing prompt-send cleanup and prevents malformed provider transcripts without fabricated tool results.

options.title: Require Synthetic Result Policy
options.body: Ask for a revised patch that inserts explicit interrupted/cancelled tool results instead of dropping the aborted assistant turn, preserving more context at the cost of fabricated state.

options.title: Pause For Richer Recovery Design
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers define a broader interrupted-turn recovery contract shared by compaction, replay, and persisted session repair.

recommendation.title: Accept Drop Policy
recommendation.body: Merge this approach after exact-head checks because it matches existing prompt-send cleanup and prevents malformed provider transcripts without fabricated tool results.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest history signal for the compaction and agent-runtime boundary where this policy lands.
